newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bahia cocoa arrivals 53,420 bags in last week.
newsitem.headline: Bahia cocoa arrivals 53,420 bags in last week.

text.p: Bahia cocoa arrivals were 53,420 bags in the week ending September 22 compared to 25,905 bags in corresponding week to September 24 last year, the Brazilian Trade Commission Comcauba said in a statement.

Comcauba in the statement clarified previously published arrivals figures for the week to September 15 of 209,329 bags by explaining this included information on arrivals since May from one company which had not been contributing data.
Actual arrivals in the week to September 15 were 63,329 bags, Comcauba said.
Total arrivals for the 1996/97 crop to-date were 1,647,423 bags against 990,554 bags in 1995/96 and 1,642,423 bags in 1994/95.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
